bullets: • Specify what appears when data source is empty or missing entirely.
• Name each displayed value; omit data structure or fetch implementation.
• Define sort order explicitly, including tie-breaking rules by field.
• State edge cases: zero counts, absent attributes, boundary conditions.
• Require one testable assertion per criterion; avoid compound logic.
• Describe user-visible outcome, never internal calculation or transformation method.
• Clarify when content displays versus when placeholder text replaces it.
• Assert only observable table structure, row content, and order.
